name: Standing privileges
short_description: Permissions, especially administrative rights, that are permanently active even when they are not being used, which enlarges the attack surface if an account is compromised.

evidence.quote: So first, let's talk about why standing privileges are such a problem.
Agents should operate on the principle of zero standing privilege.
every role assignment is time bound and standing privileges are treated as a rare failure of design
Second, standing privilege. The access remains because removing it is work
